notes: Admins: product, pet and listing reviews open like a store page, with a large photo you can flip through, thumbnails underneath and the price up top.
Admins: product lists show bigger photos.
Admins: lists show a picture of what each row is about: member photos on reports, jobs, logs, testers, couriers, sellers and tickets, and listing photos and course covers in pending approvals.
Admins: sticker and sticker pack images load again.
Limes start playing much sooner after you swipe: the next Lime loads ahead of time and the cover no longer lingers once the video is ready.
Admins: Product Review shows each listing's photos, price, seller and full description, and pending listings have Approve and Reject buttons.
Profile pictures now show everywhere people appear: admin lists and reports, chats, search, comments, likes, community members, events, jobs, blogs, courses, projects and Limes reposts.
Fixes: the Limes mention list no longer shows a stock photo for people without a profile picture.
Admins: lists, cards and buttons across the admin area lay out properly again. Rows had been stacking their icon, text and arrow on top of each other.
Admins: Moderation shows member reports again, and Communities shows each community's real member count and total memberships.
Admins: screen titles no longer get cut off by the action button at the top.
Quick updates no longer repeat the app version in What's new; Release notes lists them by date.
Saved: save posts, limes, blogs, jobs, events, market and eHub products, eHub providers, communities, courses and pets with one bookmark button, then find them all on the new Saved page.
Saved: filter by type, search your saved items, and see when something you saved was removed, made private or is no longer available.
Saved: your market and eHub favorites from this phone move into Saved the next time you sign in, and the Saved filter on the home feed now shows your saved posts.
Admins: a redesigned admin area with a clearer overview, its own screen for users, moderation, page access, security and seller review, and search plus one Filters button on every list.
Admins: actions that can't be undone ask you to confirm first, and lists load more as you go instead of stopping at 100.
Support: closing or resolving a ticket now asks you to confirm first.

Fixes: deleted products no longer show as active for admins, rejected jobs keep their reason, appeals can't be approved while the content stays deleted, and admin screens follow your light or dark theme.

E-Projects: turn on extra tools per project: a timeline that explains dates and what tasks wait on, deliverables with review and sign-off, and a register for risks, issues, decisions and change requests.
E-Projects: your logged time is private to you (managers see totals), invited clients or reviewers see only what you share, and there's a project report and an outcome summary when you finish.
E-Learning instructors: grade with rubrics, allow resubmissions, set late rules and penalties, answer grade review requests, and run classes with assistants and scheduled sessions.
E-Learning: learning paths and suggestions that say why, courses that require others first, and verified certificates you can share and choose to show on your profile.
Fixed: switching to the task board could freeze the app, and project tab names could disappear after switching tabs.
E-Projects: invitations sent by email now expire after 14 days. Project managers see which ones expired and can resend them.
E-Projects: people who have blocked each other can't invite each other to projects or get task and mention alerts from each other.
Communities: owners and admins get a notice when a project asks to be linked, which opens the Community's Projects tab.
E-Projects: tasks published from a saved draft now tell the people assigned to them.
E-Projects: your running task timer is now private. It used to be stored on your public profile.
E-Projects: inviting someone by email no longer reveals whether they have an Ourlime account. There are limits on how many invites can be sent per hour, and a project can have up to 100 milestones.
E-Projects: milestones are now checked by Ourlime. Only the person who added a milestone, or the project's managers, can edit, complete or delete it.
E-Projects: you're notified when you're invited to a project, assigned a task or mentioned, and nobody gets duplicate alerts.
E-Projects: link a project to a Community you belong to. Once the Community's owner or admins approve, it shows on the Community's new Projects tab. Joining the Community doesn't open the project.
E-Projects: with no projects yet, the screen shows one Start a project button instead of two.
E-Learning instructors can post course announcements, see their draft courses' lessons, and see how many learners finish and where they stop.
E-Learning: course videos and files open through short-lived secure links. Reviews and discussions show students as first name and initial.
Fixed: replies to course discussions didn't load.
E-Projects redesigned: start from a template (class project, event, volunteer campaign and more) with starter tasks and milestones, or a blank project.
Each project has an Overview (what needs attention, next steps, recent activity), Tasks as a list or a board you swipe through, Milestones and Team.
Archiving, completing and reopening a project now asks first and is recorded in the project's activity. Fixed: invites, role changes and transfers failing on many projects.
Removed project options that did nothing, such as public visibility, repeating tasks and some automations, and plan limits and Premium claims that weren't real.
E-Learning redesigned: Continue learning on the hub, a clearer course page that explains how you finish, and lessons that keep their formatting.
Quizzes are marked by Ourlime, so your score, the right answers and explanations show after each attempt. Your best score counts and every attempt is kept in Grades.
Quizzes and assignments count once you submit them. Handing in an assignment completes that lesson.
Instructors: clearer course states, the reviewer's note when a course isn't approved with a way to submit again, real enrolment and to-grade numbers, and an attempts limit for quizzes.
Administrators: an E-Learning review screen to approve or decline instructor applications and courses.

Administrators: a new Pending approvals screen lists everything waiting for a decision (couriers, sellers, listings, jobs, courses, instructors, identity checks, reports and more), grouped by section.
The menu button and the Pending approvals menu item show how many items are waiting. The count refreshes every minute and when you come back to the app; nothing is sent as a notification.
Fixed: moving several applicants at once, loading profiles and search could fail on some phones because of an unsupported feature.
Posting a job or a quick task is now 5 short steps with a progress bar. Next checks only that step and points to anything missing, and the last step shows a summary before you post.
Managing your listings: closing, archiving, accepting or rejecting now asks first and says what happens. Notes, activity and interview sheets have clearer layouts and Try again when something fails.
Selecting several applicants only offers the moves all of them can make, so accepted or rejected applicants can't be moved back by mistake.
Editing a listing keeps Save off until you change something and asks before throwing away unsaved edits. Delete and identity check screens are easier to read, including in dark mode.
Instructors: creating a course has a step bar, problems shown on the field or lesson they belong to, a warning before leaving with unsaved work, and Publish only once the checklist is done.
Quiz and assignment builders are laid out as cards with clear errors and a Save bar. Grading is one list with the student, what they handed in, when, and the status in words.
The instructor application, CXC, grades, discussions, class schedule and course work screens match the new E-Learning look.
Fixed: the typing dots in chat, the voice note recording dot and the floating repost bubbles on Limes could slow the app down or freeze it.
Jobs: cleaner job cards with the pay shown clearly, when the job was posted and when it closes, and your Applied and Saved status at a glance. Made-up applicant and view counts are gone.
Jobs: quick filter chips, a Filters sheet that shows how many jobs match, and a list of the filters you have on that you can remove one by one.
Job pages show the key facts (pay, type, location, experience, closing date) in a grid, a Read more for long descriptions, and an Apply bar at the bottom that changes to Applied · View status.
Applying shows which step you are on and ends with what happens next. My applications shows each status in words with a timeline, and withdrawing asks you to confirm first.
Editing a job: requirements and qualifications are now one per line, so a requirement with commas in it is no longer split into pieces.
E-Learning: new course cards with the instructor, rating (only when there are ratings), level and price, or your progress with Continue if you are enrolled. Courses has Popular, New and Free rows.
Course pages list what the course really includes (lessons, videos, quizzes, assignments), show the syllabus by module, and keep the Enroll or Continue button at the bottom.
Lessons: a thin bar shows Lesson 3 of 12, and Previous, Mark complete and Next sit at the bottom. The lesson list opens from the bottom, grouped by module.
Quizzes show one question at a time and end with a review of your answers. Assignments show their status in words and how long until they are due.
My Learning starts with Continue where you left off. The E-Learning banner now changes slides again.
E-Hub product cards are cleaner: the price stands out (sale prices in red with the old price crossed out), stock only shows when it's low or sold out, and buttons no longer cut off their text.
The button beside Add to cart is now a labelled Compare box. Tick two products and a Compare bar appears at the bottom; tap View to see price, stock, delivery and pickup side by side.
The quick add button turns into a tick once the product is in your cart.

The E-Hub banner now changes slides on its own and fades smoothly. Swipe it, or use the arrows, dots or pause button; it stops moving once you take over, and stays still if your phone's Reduce Motion setting is on.

New product page: a full-width photo gallery you can swipe or tap for full screen, price with % off, stock, size and colour choices that show what you picked, a quantity picker and an Add to cart bar that stays at the bottom.
Product pages also show clear delivery and pickup details and the seller's card, with View store and Message buttons.
Order requests start with a ready-made message listing what you're ordering, which you can edit, plus a reminder to pay on pickup or delivery.
Fixed the app freezing ("Ourlime isn't responding") while pages were loading, including E-Hub and the home feed. Loading placeholders no longer pulse.
Sharing a job, event or anything else from the app now always includes its ourlime.com link, so WhatsApp and other apps show a preview card with a picture.
Admin job moderation: Remove now takes a job listing down for good and it disappears from the jobs list, instead of staying there marked Rejected.
E-Hub cart: picking size "M" and colour "M" on the same product now keeps two separate items in your cart instead of merging them.
E-Learning quizzes: short-answer questions no longer count against your score, so getting every multiple-choice question right gives you 100%.
Jobs: a job's closing date now lasts the whole day you pick, so choosing today works and jobs no longer close the evening before.
Jobs: managing applicants follows the same steps as the website (review, interview, offer, accept), including bulk changes; only the applicant can withdraw an application.
E-Projects: due dates set on the website no longer show a day early in the app.
E-Learning: lessons you finished on the website count in the app, and assignment grades show as the right percentage (8 out of 10 is 80%).
Blogs: links and markup that could run code are removed from posts before you see them.
E-Hub cart: changing a quantity to less than one removes the item instead of leaving an empty line.

Fixes: the back button on a Lime you opened from a link now works. If the link opened the app, it takes you to your Limes feed (the phone's back gesture does the same) instead of doing nothing or closing the app.
In case you missed it: today's updates are listed below. From now on, every update shows what's new after it installs, and "An update is ready" lists what it brings before you download.
E-Hub order requests: from your cart, send each seller a request with pickup or delivery and pick one of the couriers they work with. No payment is taken; the seller confirms in your enquiries.
E-Hub has a fresh design: one menu on every page (Shop, Professionals, Storefronts, My enquiries, Sell), swipeable professional cards above the catalog, and a shorter home page.
Couriers: "Register as a courier" is on the E-Hub home under Sell on E-Hub. Sellers pick the couriers they trust in Seller Center → Preferred couriers.
My enquiries: the E-Hub inbox now opens on the enquiries you sent and their replies, and remembers which tab you were on.
E-Hub Seller Center: "Offer services" takes you straight to the services you offer and the areas you cover, so you show under Professionals.
E-Hub: storefronts that offer services now appear under Professionals, even when they also sell products.
"You're up to date" in Settings now shows what's in the version you have, with a link to all release notes.

Fixes: E-Hub enquiry notifications open your enquiries instead of "TICKET_NOT_FOUND"; the order request Send button is reachable; seller applications explain expired uploads instead of "INTERNAL"; Add to cart fits.
Fixes: the E-Hub order request form now scrolls all the way down, so the "Send order request" button is no longer hidden below the screen.

E-Hub: new order requests. From your cart, send each seller a request with pickup or delivery and pick one of the couriers they work with. No payment is taken; the seller confirms stock, price and delivery in your enquiries.
E-Hub: a fresh design. One menu on every E-Hub page (Shop, Professionals, Storefronts, My enquiries, Sell), redesigned professional cards you can swipe through, and a shorter home page.
E-Hub: professionals now show above the product catalog. When none are listed yet, you can offer your services right there.
E-Hub: "Register as a courier" is now in the Sell on E-Hub section, so delivery services can sign up and be chosen by sellers and buyers.
E-Hub: the enquiry inbox is now "My enquiries", with Sent first. It remembers which tab you were on, and links to Sent open on Sent.
E-Hub: clearer product cards ("Add to cart" no longer cuts off), easier-to-read buttons, and larger tap targets.
Fixes: tapping an E-Hub enquiry notification (a new enquiry or a provider's reply) now opens your E-Hub enquiries instead of showing "TICKET_NOT_FOUND".
Fixes: the seller application now says "government ID" when that upload has expired.
E-Hub Seller Center: new "Offer services" option opens your storefront straight on the services you offer and the areas you cover, so you are listed under Professionals.
E-Hub: storefronts that offer services now show under Professionals even when they also sell products.
Fixes: the seller application no longer fails with "INTERNAL". If an ID or proof of address upload expired (they are deleted after 24 hours until you submit), it says which one to choose again.
Events: if your identity is not verified yet, the event form offers verification right away and keeps what you filled in.
Events: scheduled events get their post in the home feed, the same as on the website.

Events: the event form now matches the website: online or in person, venue on the map, ticket price, accessibility, minimum age, co-organizers, registration questions, custom repeats, drafts and scheduling.
Events: published events appear in the home feed, and "Event" in Create post opens the full event form.
Events: hosting or editing a community event uses the same full form. The host can cancel an event from its post in the feed.
Jobs: employers get an email when someone applies, and applicants are emailed when a listing changes in a big way.
Jobs: pause and resume a listing, edit its closing date and screening questions, and pick interview times with a date picker.
Jobs: check your application on a review screen before sending it. Quick tasks no longer ask screening questions.
Fixes: tags and extra photos added in the app now show on the website, and jobs posted from the app show their type, experience and closing date there. Tapping a job in Discover opens that job.

E-Hub Seller Center: run more than one storefront under your business account. Use "New storefront" to set one up; each has its own products, drafts and public page, and your other storefronts stay as they are.
E-Hub: the Shop page goes straight from the products to professionals. Storefronts are under Discover → Explore storefronts.
Seller application: choose "Individual seller" or "Registered business" from two clear options that say which documents each needs.
Seller application: local phone numbers like 710-4296 or 868-710-4296 are accepted, and each missing or wrong field is marked in red with what to fix.
Fixes: the seller application no longer jumps to another field while it saves, uploads or submits.
Fixes: in posts with several photos, the arrows now move to the next photo. Before, the counter changed but the first photo stayed on screen.
Fixes: photos in a post show in the order they were picked, the same as on the website.
Posts with a YouTube link show the link and the YouTube player only, without a second preview card underneath.
The launch screen shows the Ourlime logo without the black box, matching the logo inside the app.
When a new version is on the Play Store, Update now opens Ourlime in the Play Store so you can update it there.
Includes every quick update since 1.3.1: couriers, pet adoption contact details and review, instructor applications that are kept if Android closes the app, and the transparent logo.
Fixes: Check for updates now says when it could not reach the update server, with the reason, instead of showing "You're up to date".
The Ourlime logo in the header, the Limes tab, loading screens, sign-in, registration and policy pages now has a transparent background instead of a black box.

Couriers: delivery businesses can register their courier service from the new Couriers tile in Lime Market, with the areas they cover, their vehicles, delivery options and a starting price. Ourlime reviews each one before it is listed.
Couriers: browse approved couriers by area and call, WhatsApp or email them straight from the directory.
Sellers can pick up to five preferred couriers (My listings → Preferred couriers, or E-Hub Seller Center → Settings). They show on the seller's Lime Market and E-Hub products.
Checkout: when you choose Standard shipping you can optionally pick a courier, starting with the seller's preferred ones.
Admins review courier registrations under Admin → Couriers: approve, decline with a reason, or suspend.

Become an instructor: your application is saved on your phone as you fill it in. If Android closes Ourlime while you pick your resume or certificates, everything you typed and attached is back when you reopen the form.
Pets for Adoption: choosing Phone or Email as your preferred enquiry method now asks for the number or address, and signed-in members can call or email you from the pet's page.

Pets for Adoption: admins get a notification when a pet is submitted and can approve or decline it under Admin → Pet Adoption. Carers are notified when their pet is approved or declined, and when someone sends an adoption enquiry.
Limes opens faster: its For You feed now loads in the background when the app starts, like Home and Communities, so the first visit no longer waits on the network.
Pets for Adoption: submit a pet with up to 6 photos, its temperament, health and adoption requirements, and pick its town from a list. Breed is optional.
Pets for Adoption: each pet has its own page with all its photos and details, and carers can mark a pet adoption pending or adopted.
Pets for Adoption: carers review and answer adoption enquiries under Manage enquiries, and the Adoption Programme page explains how it works.
Pets for Adoption is now adoption only, the same as the website: pets are never sold, and there is no checkout or payment.
Fixes: pet forms stay on screen while you type, instead of sliding the field you are typing in out of view.
Lime Market: Sell on Ourlime, My listings, My orders, Pets & Adoption and Support are now shortcut tiles at the top of the Market, so you no longer scroll past every product to reach them.
E-Hub: a new Offer your services card and a Join as a pro button show plumbers, masons, designers and other professionals how to register, with a step-by-step guide in the Seller Center.

Date pickers: choosing a date or time now opens Ourlime's own calendar, with the month grid, hour and minute buttons and AM/PM, the same on every phone. It's used for task deadlines, event dates, schedules and blog sources.
Links: ourlime.com links to your profile, Discover, Limes and the sign-in page now open those screens in the app instead of a "Page not found" screen.
Fixes: in a task's details, the priority options and the Details, Subtasks, Comments and Time tabs now respond to the first tap while the keyboard is open.
Ads: the full Ads Marketplace is in the app. Browse ad spaces, book an offer with your ad materials, follow bookings, submit proof of delivery and leave reviews.
Ads: become a host as a business or influencer, create and publish offers, manage them from your host dashboard and track verification.
Jobs: a redesigned Jobs page with search, categories and full filters, the complete job and quick-task forms, save and share, and every job detail section.
Events: featured events, Upcoming Events and a Calendar, full filters, discussions, reviews and galleries on event pages, and event photos and categories now save.
E-Projects: project pages now have timeline, workload, files, milestones and timesheets, a full task sheet with comments, timers and files, and team settings.
E-Learning: plan your week in Schedule Work, see a course's quizzes and assignments before you enrol, and create courses with a file library and publish checklist.
Profile: edit work, education, interests, skills and phone numbers, see social links, a full Friends page with filters, and manage your block list in Settings.
Games: GeoGuesser has hints, skips, streak bonuses and a leaderboard, and Wordle has hints, a dictionary and Limey.
Market: quick variant presets for each category, a category breadcrumb, removable filter chips and a full receipt after checkout. E-Hub screens have section tabs.
Home: a Promoted card, find-and-add friends on the Friends feed, every notification filter, and appeals for removed content.
Sign-up and help: registration matches the website and saves your progress, the full policies are in the app, and help tickets and safety reports match the website.
Admin: Jobs, Game Content, Security and Seed Stickers pages, deleted-content review and bulk actions, and disabling a sticker now hides it.

E-Learning: a redesigned home that matches the website, with a welcome card, quick links, a rotating banner with search, swipeable course updates, and course cards you can filter by category and subcategory.
E-Learning: Tutors now show each instructor's rating, with Show all for longer lists.

E-Learning: lesson text keeps its formatting (headings, lists, links), CXC past papers open with Study and the CXC hub has a subject search, and instructors get a Create Course button in the course catalog.
Market: share any listing straight from the catalog, and sellers can set one price and stock for every variant at once.
Market: new Pets & Adoption section. Browse pets to adopt or buy, search and filter them, save favourites and see each pet's details.
Pets & Adoption: send a carer an enquiry, list a pet for review, and read the pet safety guide and local shelter details.
Market: sellers can add up to 3 videos (MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 50 MB each) to a listing's gallery alongside photos, and buyers can play them on the listing.
Links: ourlime.com links to Market orders and checkout, E-Hub searches, provider services and the E-Hub terms sections now open the right place in the app.
Updates: the download bar now moves while a quick update downloads, and a stalled download stops after 3 minutes so you can try again.
Loading screens across the app now show the real page's layout (headers, sections and cards) while content loads.
What's new: the list now scrolls, with a close button and a link to all release notes always in view.
Updates: the download sheet now reads "Downloading the update" and says Ourlime restarts when it's ready.
E-Learning: a course home for enrolled students with Next up, a to-do list of quizzes and assignments, recent activity and resources, plus Modules, Quizzes and Assignments pages.
E-Learning: lessons open exactly where you tapped, Continue picks up at your next lesson, and Mark as Done moves you on.
E-Learning: filter courses by level and free or paid, sort by newest or top rated, and see which courses you're enrolled in.
E-Learning for instructors: create quizzes and assignments, save grades as drafts, and apply with the full instructor application.
E-Learning fixes: lessons added as documents now show up, and quizzes with short-answer questions are scored correctly.
E-Hub: save products, compare two side by side and keep a preparation cart, plus a new home with Shop, Hire, Discover and Grow.
E-Hub: ask a provider about a specific service, share provider profiles, read the E-Hub terms in the app, and delete an enquiry before it's read.
Market: product pages with colour and size options, reviews, related items, shipping details and Report listing.
Market: checkout with shipping or pickup, including each seller's pickup contacts, plus My orders to track, confirm and review.
Market for sellers: My listings to add, edit, unpublish and duplicate products, and seller orders to mark items shipped or ready for pickup.
Market: more filters (seller type, colour, size, in stock, newest), saved searches, save for later and a grid or list view.
Updates are now required: when a new version or quick update is ready, Ourlime shows it and you tap Update now to continue. The update screen can't be closed until it's installed.
You now get a notification when a quick update is ready, not only for new versions on Google Play.
Typing: the keyboard no longer covers what you're typing. Lime captions, comments, reports, settings, job and event forms, chats with support and every other text box now stay above the keyboard.
Lime cover: Edit cover now opens on the frame you picked on Confirm video, instead of jumping back to the start.
What's new now has a "See all release notes" link to Settings → Release notes, where you can read what changed in every version.
Lime video cover: the cover you pick in Edit cover is now saved exactly, instead of a nearby frame that could be a second or more away.
Quick updates now wait for you: when one is ready, Ourlime asks first, and nothing is downloaded or installed until you tap "Update now". Tap Later and the app stays as it is.
Release notes: Settings → Release notes lists what changed in every version and quick update.
Lime video cover: the Finish button in Edit cover works on the first tap, and the frame strip loads even after you've already picked a cover.
E-Hub forms: the keyboard no longer covers what you type in Seller Center, your business account, enquiries and the enquiry form on a provider's page.
Business account: a category you typed is now saved when you tap Save, even if you didn't tap Add first.
Sharing an E-Hub product now sends just the link, so chats show the product's name, price and photo.
Fixes: long descriptions scroll inside their box so you can see what you're typing, image upload problems show a clear message, and the draft delete button reads "Delete draft".
Updates from Google Play: when a new version of Ourlime is out, the app tells you right away and installs it through Play's own update screen, without sending you to the store.
Fixes: the "What's new" list now scrolls, so you can read every note and reach the "Got it" button.
E-Hub is in the app: browse the catalog, open product pages, discover sellers and service providers, view their profiles and send enquiries.
E-Hub Seller Center: set up your storefront, add and edit products, and see how your shop is doing.
Business account: create and manage your business profile from the app.
Course lessons: watch lesson videos, take quizzes and open lesson files (PDF, Word) without leaving the app.
Assignments: hand in a written answer and files, then see your grade and your instructor's feedback.
New progress & grades page for each course: completion, average quiz score and your result for every lesson.
Course reviews: read what other students say and leave your own rating.
Teach on Ourlime: apply to become an instructor, create and publish courses, and grade your students' work.
Events: a new event page with comments, plus a Calendar view that shows what's on each day.
Games: a new Games hub with Trini Wordle and Trini GeoGuesser. Find places across T&T on the map and climb the leaderboard.
Fixes: E-Learning and E-Hub screens that wouldn't load, Seller Center closing on open, broken card layouts, and member names that showed an email address.
